ActivateOfficeSite.description_en: Unlocks an office network based on a convenience account that has been automatically locked after being idle for a certain period
ActivateOfficeSite.description_zh: 基于便捷账号的办公网络闲置一定时间后将被自动锁定。调用本接口可解锁

AddFilePermission.description_en: Creates a shared folder in a cloud disk
AddFilePermission.description_zh: 在网盘内新增共享的文件夹

AddUserToDesktopGroup.description_en: Adds authorized users to a shared cloud computer. Cloud computers within the shared cloud computer are automatically assigned to authorized users based on rules set by the administrator
AddUserToDesktopGroup.description_zh: 为共享型云电脑添加授权用户。共享型云电脑内的云电脑会按照管理员设置的规则自动分配给授权用户使用

ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Attaches an automatic snapshot policy to cloud computers. After the policy is attached, cloud computers perform automatic creation of snapshots at the times specified in the automatic snapshot policy
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 为云电脑绑定自动快照策略。绑定后，云电脑将按照自动快照策略规定的时间自动创建快照

ApplyCoordinatePrivilege.description_en: Requests permissions for stream coordination operations

ApplyCoordinationForMonitoring.description_en: Sends a remote assistance request from an administrator to an end user. This operation is mainly used in administrator assistance scenarios and education scenarios
ApplyCoordinationForMonitoring.description_zh: 管理员向终端用户发起远程协助请求。主要用于管理员协助场景和教育场景

AssociateNetworkPackage.description_en: Associates a premium Internet bandwidth plan with an office network. A premium Internet bandwidth plan has a one-to-one relationship with an office network
AssociateNetworkPackage.description_zh: 将公网精品带宽绑定至办公网络。公网精品带宽和办公网络是一对一的绑定关系

AttachCen.description_en: Associates an advanced office network with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
AttachCen.description_zh: 将高级办公网络与云企业网实例绑定

AttachEndUser.description_en: If you want a hardware terminal to be accessible only to specified end users, you need to enable the trusted device authentication feature and add bound users to the hardware terminal
AttachEndUser.description_zh: 如果希望硬件终端只能被指定的终端用户登录，您需要开启可信设备认证功能，并为硬件终端添加绑定用户

BatchModifyEntitlement.description_en: Assigns users to multiple cloud computers in a batch
BatchModifyEntitlement.description_zh: 批量分配用户到多台云电脑

BindConfigGroup.description_en: Associates a configuration group with a cloud computer or resource group
BindConfigGroup.description_zh: 将配置组与云电脑或资源组绑定

CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Cancels an automatic snapshot policy for cloud computers
CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 取消云电脑的自动快照策略

CancelCoordinationForMonitoring.description_en: Cancels a remote assistance request initiated to an end user
CancelCoordinationForMonitoring.description_zh: 取消向终端用户发起的远程协助请求

CancelCopyImage.description_en: Cancels an ongoing image copy operation to another region
CancelCopyImage.description_zh: 取消将镜像复制至另一地域的操作

CloneCenterPolicy.description_en: Clones a policy based on an existing region-independent policy
CloneCenterPolicy.description_zh: 基于现有无地域策略克隆出一个策略

ClonePolicyGroup.description_en: Clones a cloud computer policy to quickly create a custom cloud computer policy
ClonePolicyGroup.description_zh: 通过克隆云电脑策略来实现快速创建自定义云电脑策略的目的

CompleteCdsFile.description_en: Completes the file upload action after a file upload task is created
CompleteCdsFile.description_zh: 创建文件上传任务后，调用本接口完成上传动作

ConfigADConnectorTrust.description_en: Configures a trust relationship for an AD office network. For office networks (formerly workspaces) that use the HDX protocol, you must configure conditional forwarders and trust relationships before the networks can function properly
ConfigADConnectorTrust.description_zh: 对于采用HDX协议的办公网络（原工作区），需要配置条件转发器和信任关系后方可正常使用。可调用本接口为AD办公网络配置信任关系

ConfigADConnectorUser.description_en: Specifies the organizational unit (OU) and administrator for an AD office network (formerly workspace)
ConfigADConnectorUser.description_zh: 为AD办公网络（原工作区）指定组织单元OU和管理员

CopyCdsFile.description_en: Creates a copy of a file or folder in a cloud drive
CopyCdsFile.description_zh: 为网盘中的文件或文件夹制作一个副本

CopyImage.description_en: Copies an image to another region. To share an image across regions, call this operation to copy the image to the destination region first, and then share it
CopyImage.description_zh: 将镜像复制到另一地域。如需跨地域分享镜像，可以先调用本接口将镜像复制到新地域再进行分享

CreateADConnectorOfficeSite.description_en: Creates an office network (formerly workspace) based on an enterprise Active Directory (AD) account system. Elastic Desktop Service supports convenient accounts and enterprise AD accounts
CreateADConnectorOfficeSite.description_zh: 无影云电脑支持便捷账号和企业AD账号这两种账号体系。本接口用于创建一个基于企业AD账号的办公网络（原工作区）

CreateAndBindNasFileSystem.description_en: Creates a NAS file system and binds it to the office network of a shared cloud computer
CreateAndBindNasFileSystem.description_zh: 创建NAS文件系统并且绑定到共享型云电脑的办公网络

CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Creates an automatic snapshot policy that enables cloud computers to perform automatic creation of snapshots based on the schedule specified by a Cron expression
CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 创建自动快照策略，让云电脑按照Cron表达式对应的时间自动创建快照

CreateBundle.description_en: Creates a custom cloud computer template
CreateBundle.description_zh: 创建自定义的云电脑模板

CreateCdsFile.description_en: Create a folder or initiate a file upload task in the cloud disk
CreateCdsFile.description_zh: 在网盘中创建文件夹或者创建文件上传任务

CreateCenterPolicy.description_en: Creates a region-independent Cloud Desktop policy
CreateCenterPolicy.description_zh: 创建一条无地域的云电脑策略

CreateCloudDriveService.description_en: Creates an enterprise network-attached storage (NAS) drive (formerly Wuying CloudDisk)
CreateCloudDriveService.description_zh: 创建企业网盘（原无影云盘）

CreateCloudDriveUsers.description_en: Adds a personal drive for a user in an enterprise network drive
CreateCloudDriveUsers.description_zh: 在企业网盘中添加用户个人盘

CreateConfigGroup.description_en: Creates a configuration group. A configuration group contains the configuration information of scheduled tasks in a Cloud Desktop center
CreateConfigGroup.description_zh: 创建配置组。配置组中包含云电脑中心定时任务的配置信息

CreateDesktops.description_en: Creates one or more cloud computers. If user information is provided during creation, the cloud computers are assigned directly
CreateDesktops.description_zh: 创建一台或多台云电脑。创建时若传入用户信息，可直接完成云电脑的分配

CreateDiskEncryptionService.description_en: Enables the disk encryption feature and adds the service-linked role (SLR) for enterprise cloud disk encryption under the RAM user
CreateDiskEncryptionService.description_zh: 开启磁盘加密功能，在用户RAM下添加企业网盘加密的服务关联角色（SLR）

CreateDrive.description_zh: 创建用户级别存储资源

CreateEcdReportTask.description_en: Creates a data report export task
CreateEcdReportTask.description_zh: 创建数据报表导出任务

CreateImage.description_en: Creates a custom image from a deployed cloud computer to quickly create more cloud computers with the same configuration, avoiding repeated configuration each time
CreateImage.description_zh: 通过已部署好的云电脑创建自定义镜像，以便快速创建更多相同配置的云电脑，避免每次创建时重复配置

CreateNetworkPackage.description_en: Creates a premium bandwidth plan for an office network
CreateNetworkPackage.description_zh: 为办公网络创建一个公网精品带宽

CreateOfficeSiteAccelerator.description_en: Enables Global Accelerator (GA) for an office network
CreateOfficeSiteAccelerator.description_zh: 为办公网络开通全球加速

CreateSimpleOfficeSite.description_en: Elastic Desktop Service supports two account systems: convenience accounts and enterprise AD accounts. Creates an office network (formerly workspace) based on convenience accounts
CreateSimpleOfficeSite.description_zh: 无影云电脑支持便捷账号和企业AD账号这两种账号体系。本接口用于创建一个基于便捷账号的办公网络（原工作区）

CreateSnapshot.description_en: Create a snapshot for a disk of a cloud computer to back up or restore the data on the disk
CreateSnapshot.description_zh: 为云电脑的磁盘创建一份快照，用于备份和恢复磁盘上的数据

CreateTemplate.description_en: Creates a custom cloud computer template. A cloud computer template is a collection of cloud computer configurations that reduces the configuration steps and accelerates the creation of cloud computers
CreateTemplate.description_zh: 创建一个自定义的云电脑模板。云电脑模板（简称模板）是云电脑配置的合集，用于减少创建云电脑时的配置步骤，加快创建云电脑的速度

DeleteBundles.description_zh: 删除一个或多个自定义云电脑模板

DeleteCdsFile.description_en: Deletes a file or folder from a cloud drive
DeleteCdsFile.description_zh: 删除网盘中的文件或文件夹

DeleteCloudDriveUsers.description_en: Delete the personal drive of a user in WUYING Workspace
DeleteCloudDriveUsers.description_zh: 删除企业网盘内的用户个人盘

DeleteDesktops.description_en: Releases one or more pay-as-you-go cloud computers or expired subscription cloud computers
DeleteDesktops.description_zh: 释放一台或多台按量付费云电脑或到期的包年包月云电脑

DeleteImages.description_en: Deletes one or more custom images
DeleteImages.description_zh: 删除一个或多个自定义镜像

DeleteNASFileSystems.description_zh: 删除一个或者多个NAS文件系统

DeleteNetworkPackages.description_en: Deletes one or more premium Internet bandwidth plans
DeleteNetworkPackages.description_zh: 删除一个或者多个公网精品带宽

DeleteOfficeSites.description_zh: 将办公网络（原工作区）内的云电脑资源完全释放后可以将办公网络删除

DeletePolicyGroups.description_en: Deletes one or more custom cloud computer policies
DeletePolicyGroups.description_zh: 删除一个或多个自定义云电脑策略

DeleteSnapshot.description_zh: 用于删除一份或多份快照

DeleteTemplates.description_en: Deletes a custom cloud computer template
DeleteTemplates.description_zh: 删除自定义云电脑模板

DeleteVirtualBridge.description_en: Modifies the status of a virtual bridge

DeleteVirtualMFADevice.description_en: Removes a virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device that is associated with an Active Directory (AD) account
DeleteVirtualMFADevice.description_zh: 删除AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

DescribeAclEntries.description_en: Queries the details of an access control list (ACL) of an office network or a cloud computer
DescribeAclEntries.description_zh: 查询办公网络或云电脑粒度上的公网访问控制策略详情

DescribeBundles.description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer templates
DescribeBundles.description_zh: 查询云电脑模板的详细信息

DescribeCdsFileShareLinks.description_en: Queries file sharing links of a cloud disk in Cloud Drive Service

DescribeCens.description_en: Queries information about all Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances under the current account
DescribeCens.description_zh: 查询账号下所有云企业网实例信息

DescribeCenterPolicyList.description_en: Queries the details of regionless policies
DescribeCenterPolicyList.description_zh: 查询无地域策略的详细信息

DescribeClientEvents.description_en: Queries the operation logs of end users, including events such as cloud computer startup, shutdown, and session disconnection
DescribeClientEvents.description_zh: 查询终端用户的操作日志，包括云电脑的开机、关机、会话断开等事件

DescribeCloudDiskGroupDrives.description_en: Queries the list of cloud disk team spaces
DescribeCloudDiskGroupDrives.description_zh: 查询云盘团队空间列表

DescribeCloudDiskGroups.description_en: Queries the list of cloud disk teams

DescribeCloudDriveGroups.description_en: Queries the list and basic information of all team shared drives in an enterprise cloud drive
DescribeCloudDriveGroups.description_zh: 查询企业网盘内所有团队共享盘的列表及基本信息

DescribeCloudDrivePermissions.description_en: Queries the permission settings of an enterprise cloud drive
DescribeCloudDrivePermissions.description_zh: 查询企业网盘的权限设置详情

DescribeCloudDriveUsers.description_en: Retrieves a list of personal drives and their basic information for all users in an enterprise network drive
DescribeCloudDriveUsers.description_zh: 查询企业网盘内所有用户个人盘的列表及基本信息

DescribeConfigGroup.description_en: Queries the list of configuration groups

DescribeCustomizedListHeaders.description_en: Obtain the table header information of the WUYING Workspace list page.
DescribeCustomizedListHeaders.description_zh: 获取云电脑列表页的表头信息

DescribeDesktopGroupSessions.description_en: Queries the session monitoring details of shared cloud computers
DescribeDesktopGroupSessions.description_zh: 查询共享型云电脑会话监控详情

DescribeDesktopGroups.description_en: Queries the list and details of shared cloud computers
DescribeDesktopGroups.description_zh: 查询共享型云电脑列表及详情

DescribeDesktopInfo.description_en: Queries the basic information of cloud computers
DescribeDesktopInfo.description_zh: 查询云电脑的基础信息

DescribeDesktopMetadata.description_en: Queries the list and metadata of cloud desktops across all regions
DescribeDesktopMetadata.description_zh: 查询全地域的桌面列表及元数据

DescribeDesktopSessions.description_en: Queries the detailed session information of cloud computers
DescribeDesktopSessions.description_zh: 查询云电脑的详细会话信息

DescribeDesktopTypes.description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer specifications
DescribeDesktopTypes.description_zh: 查询云电脑规格的详细信息

DescribeDesktops.description_en: Queries the details of cloud computers
DescribeDesktops.description_zh: 查询云电脑的详细信息

DescribeDesktopsInGroup.description_en: Queries the list of cloud desktops in a shared cloud desktop by billing method
DescribeDesktopsInGroup.description_zh: 按付费类型查询共享型云电脑包含的云电脑列表

DescribeDevices.description_en: Queries the list of trusted devices

DescribeDirectories.description_en: Queries the details of a directory

DescribeDrives.description_zh: 查询用户级别的存储资源

DescribeEcdReportTasks.description_en: Queries the list of data report export tasks
DescribeEcdReportTasks.description_zh: 查询数据报表导出任务列表

DescribeFlowMetric.description_en: Queries the inbound and outbound bandwidth monitoring data of a cloud computer, or the public inbound and outbound bandwidth monitoring data of a premium public bandwidth instance
DescribeFlowMetric.description_zh: 查询云电脑的流入带宽和流出带宽，或是公网精品带宽的公网访问流入带宽和流出带宽监控数据

DescribeFotaPendingDesktops.description_en: Queries information about the cloud computers whose images can be and are pending to be updated to the specified version
DescribeFotaPendingDesktops.description_zh: 获取可升级到指定版本镜像但尚未升级的云电脑信息

DescribeFotaTasks.description_en: Retrieves a list of image upgrade tasks
DescribeFotaTasks.description_zh: 获取镜像升级任务列表

DescribeGlobalDesktopRecords.description_en: Queries the basic information of all recent cloud desktops and their corresponding usage duration records
DescribeGlobalDesktopRecords.description_zh: 查询近期所有云电脑的基本信息，及对应的使用时长记录

DescribeGlobalTimerBatches.description_en: Queries the batch information of scheduled task execution history and returns aggregated execution results
DescribeGlobalTimerBatches.description_zh: 查询定时任务执行历史记录的批次信息，并且返回汇总的执行结果

DescribeGlobalTimerRecords.description_en: Queries the execution records of scheduled tasks for cloud computers across regions
DescribeGlobalTimerRecords.description_zh: 查询各地域云电脑的定时任务执行记录

DescribeGuestApplications.description_en: Queries the applications and their processes of an end user
DescribeGuestApplications.description_zh: 查询云电脑指定授权用户的应用和进程信息

DescribeImageModifiedRecords.description_en: Queries the image change records of a cloud computer
DescribeImageModifiedRecords.description_zh: 查询云电脑的镜像变更记录

DescribeImagePermission.description_en: Queries the recipient Alibaba Cloud accounts with which an image is shared
DescribeImagePermission.description_zh: 获取当前镜像已共享的阿里云账号列表

DescribeInvocations.description_en: Queries the execution list and status of Cloud Assistant scripts
DescribeInvocations.description_zh: 用于查询云助手脚本的执行列表和状态

DescribeKmsKeys.description_en: Queries Key Management Service (KMS) keys of users. The first time you call this operation, you can try to create a service key for Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) and call the operation to return results
DescribeKmsKeys.description_zh: 查询用户KMS密钥列表。如果是第一次访问，将尝试创建一个EDS的服务密钥，并返回结果

DescribeModificationPrice.description_en: Queries the price for upgrading or downgrading a monthly subscription (unlimited duration) cloud computer or premium Internet bandwidth
DescribeModificationPrice.description_zh: 查询按月购买不限时长云电脑或公网精品带宽的变配价格

DescribeNetworkPackages.description_en: Queries the details of one or more premium Internet bandwidth plans
DescribeNetworkPackages.description_zh: 查询一个或者多个公网精品带宽的详细信息

DescribeOfficeSites.description_en: Queries all attributes of an office network, including the ID, name, status, and creation time
DescribeOfficeSites.description_zh: 查询办公网络的所有属性，包括ID、名称、状态、创建时间等

DescribeOnlineUserCount.description_en: Queries metrics such as the number of online users and the number of users with assigned desktops
DescribeOnlineUserCount.description_zh: 查询在线用户数、已分配桌面用户数等指标

DescribePolicyGroups.description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer policies
DescribePolicyGroups.description_zh: 查询云电脑策略的详细信息

DescribePrice.description_en: Queries the purchase price of Elastic Desktop Service products
DescribePrice.description_zh: 查询无影商品的新购价格

DescribeRecordFile.description_en: Queries the list of screen recording files across all regions
DescribeRecordFile.description_zh: 查询全地域录屏文件列表

DescribeRecordings.description_en: Queries the details of screen recording files
DescribeRecordings.description_zh: 查询录屏文件的详细信息

DescribeRefundPrice.description_en: Queries the unsubscription price of cloud computers purchased on a monthly basis
DescribeRefundPrice.description_zh: 查询按月购买云电脑的退订价格

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud regions supported by WUYING Workspace
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询无影云桌面支持的阿里云地域信息

DescribeRenewalPrice.description_en: Queries the renewal price of a Wuying product
DescribeRenewalPrice.description_zh: 查询无影商品的续费价格

DescribeResourceByCenterPolicyId.description_en: Queries cloud resources that are associated with a global policy
DescribeResourceByCenterPolicyId.description_zh: 查询无地域策略绑定的云资源

DescribeSessionStatistic.description_en: Queries session statistics information across all regions
DescribeSessionStatistic.description_zh: 查询全地域的会话统计信息

DescribeSnapshots.description_en: Queries the snapshot list and detailed snapshot information of a cloud computer
DescribeSnapshots.description_zh: 查询一台云电脑的快照列表和快照的详细信息

DescribeTemplates.description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer templates

DescribeTimerGroup.description_en: Queries the details of a specified configuration group
DescribeTimerGroup.description_zh: 查询指定配置组的详细信息

DescribeUserConnectionRecords.description_en: Queries the connection records of authorized users connecting to pooled cloud computers in a cloud computer pool
DescribeUserConnectionRecords.description_zh: 查询云电脑池的授权用户连接池化云电脑的具体记录

DescribeUsersInGroup.description_en: Queries the details of all authorized users of a shared cloud computer, including the username, email address, phone number, and authorized cloud computer ID
DescribeUsersInGroup.description_zh: 查询共享型云电脑所有授权用户的详情，包括用户名、邮箱地址、手机号、获得授权的云电脑ID等

DescribeUsersPassword.description_en: Queries the password of an account in a cloud computer image. For example, when querying the query cache of passwords in the Chrome browser on a cloud computer, the end user is required to enter this password to authenticate
DescribeUsersPassword.description_zh: 查询云电脑镜像内账号的密码。例如，在云电脑上的Chrome浏览器查询缓存的密码时，会要求终端用户输入该密码进行验证

DescribeVirtualMFADevices.description_en: Queries the virtual MFA devices bound to AD accounts
DescribeVirtualMFADevices.description_zh: 查询AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

DescribeZones.description_en: Queries the zones supported by Alibaba Cloud Workspace in a specified Alibaba Cloud region
DescribeZones.description_zh: 查询无影云电脑在某一个阿里云地域下支持的可用区信息

DetachCen.description_en: Unbinds an advanced office network from a CEN instance
DetachCen.description_zh: 将高级办公网络与已加入的云企业网实例解绑

DetachEndUser.description_en: Unbinds a hardware client from a user
DetachEndUser.description_zh: 为无影硬件终端移除绑定用户

DisableDesktopsInGroup.description_en: Disables cloud computers in a shared cloud computer group. After a cloud computer is disabled, its status changes to unavailable
DisableDesktopsInGroup.description_zh: 禁用共享型云电脑中的云电脑。禁用后，云电脑的状态变为unavailable

DissociateNetworkPackage.description_en: Disassociates a premium Internet bandwidth plan from the office network to which it was previously bound
DissociateNetworkPackage.description_zh: 将公网精品带宽与此前绑定的办公网络解绑

DownloadCdsFile.description_en: Retrieves the download URL of a specified file
DownloadCdsFile.description_zh: 获取目标文件的下载链接

ExportClientEvents.description_en: Exports events that occur on a cloud desktop from an Alibaba Cloud Workspace client

ExportDesktopGroupInfo.description_en: Exports the list of shared cloud computers to an XLSX file. Each record includes the shared cloud computer ID and name, office network ID and name, shared cloud computer template, security policy name, and other details
ExportDesktopGroupInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口导出的共享型云电脑列表将保存为XLSX文件。每条共享型云电脑数据包括共享型云电脑ID和名称、办公网络ID和名称、共享型云电脑模板、安全策略名称等

ExportDesktopListInfo.description_en: Exports the cloud desktop list as a CSV file
ExportDesktopListInfo.description_zh: 将云电脑列表导出为CSV文件

GetAsyncTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a folder copy asynchronous node based on the AsyncTaskId parameter returned by the CopyCdsFile operation
GetAsyncTask.description_zh: 根据CopyCdsFile接口获得的AsyncTaskId返回参数获取文件夹复制异步任务的详细信息

GetConnectionTicket.description_en: Retrieves the connection credential for a cloud computer

GetCoordinateTicket.description_en: Retrieves the coordination flow ticket used for remote assistance or shared coordination
GetCoordinateTicket.description_zh: 获取协同流凭证，用于进行远程协助或共享协同

GetDesktopGroupDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of a shared cloud computer
GetDesktopGroupDetail.description_zh: 获取一个共享型云电脑的详细信息

GetOfficeSiteSsoStatus.description_en: Queries whether single sign-on (SSO) is enabled for an office network
GetOfficeSiteSsoStatus.description_zh: 查询办公网络是否开启了单点登录SSO功能

GetSpMetadata.description_en: Obtains the metadata of a Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0-based service provider (SP)
GetSpMetadata.description_zh: 获取基于SAML 2.0的服务提供商SP（Service Provider）的元数据

HibernateDesktops.description_zh: 对云电脑执行休眠操作

ListCdsFiles.description_en: Queries the file list in a cloud drive and retrieves download URLs for files
ListCdsFiles.description_zh: 查询网盘中的文件列表，以及获取文件的下载链接

ListDirectoryUsers.description_en: Retrieves user information from an enterprise Active Directory (AD) if you use an AD directory to connect to your enterprise AD
ListDirectoryUsers.description_zh: 如果您使用AD目录来对接企业自有AD，调用该接口可以获取企业AD中的用户信息

ListFilePermission.description_en: Queries the permissions on a shared file on a drive
ListFilePermission.description_zh: 查询网盘中的共享文件夹的权限信息

ListInstalledApps.description_en: Queries applications installed on a cloud computer
ListInstalledApps.description_zh: 查询云电脑内安装的应用

ListOfficeSiteOverview.description_en: Queries information about an office network, including its status, cloud computer quantity, virtual private cloud (VPC) type, and more
ListOfficeSiteOverview.description_zh: 查询办公网络（原工作区）的概览信息，包括状态、云电脑数量、VPC网络类型等

ListOfficeSiteUsers.description_en: Queries the AD account information obtained after an AD office network (formerly workspace) is connected to an AD domain
ListOfficeSiteUsers.description_zh: 查询AD办公网络（原工作区）对接AD域后获取的AD账号信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the list of tags that are added to cloud computers
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询云电脑已添加标签的列表

ListTransferFileDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves the download URLs of transfer files
ListTransferFileDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取传输文件的下载地址

ListTransferFiles.description_en: Queries the file information of a file transmission task
ListTransferFiles.description_zh: 查询传输任务的文件信息

ListUserAdOrganizationUnits.description_en: Obtains the organizational units (OUs) of an Active Directory (AD) domain that is connected to an enterprise AD office network (formerly workspace)
ListUserAdOrganizationUnits.description_zh: 获取AD办公网络（原工作区）对接的AD域的组织单元OU信息

ListVirtualBridges.description_en: Queries a list of virtual bridges

LockVirtualMFADevice.description_en: Locks a virtual MFA device that is in Normal state
LockVirtualMFADevice.description_zh: 锁定处于正常（NORMAL）状态的虚拟MFA设备

MigrateDesktops.description_en: Migrates cloud computers from the current office network to a new office network
MigrateDesktops.description_zh: 将云电脑从当前所属办公网络（原工作区）迁移到新的办公网络

MigrateImageProtocol.description_en: Update the protocols of images to Adaptive Streaming Protocol (ASP)
MigrateImageProtocol.description_zh: 将镜像的协议升级为ASP协议

ModifyADConnectorOfficeSite.description_en: Modifies the basic properties of an AD office network (formerly workspace), such as the office network name and the domain name of the enterprise AD subdomain
ModifyADConnectorOfficeSite.description_zh: 修改AD办公网络（原工作区）的基本属性，例如办公网络名称、企业AD子域的域名等

ModifyAclEntries.description_en: Modifies the public network access control policy at the office network or cloud computer granularity
ModifyAclEntries.description_zh: 修改办公网络或云电脑粒度上的公网访问控制策略

ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Modifies the configuration items of an automatic snapshot policy, including the policy name and snapshot retention period
ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 修改自动快照策略的配置项，包括策略名称、快照保留时间等

ModifyBundle.description_en: Modifies a custom cloud computer template
ModifyBundle.description_zh: 修改自定义云电脑模板

ModifyCdsFile.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a cloud disk file or folder, such as the file name
ModifyCdsFile.description_zh: 修改网盘文件或文件夹的属性，例如文件名

ModifyCdsFileShareLink.description_en: Modifies the link for file sharing

ModifyCenterPolicy.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a region-free policy
ModifyCenterPolicy.description_zh: 修改一条无地域策略的配置

ModifyCloudDriveGroups.description_zh: 修改团队共享盘的基本属性，例如共享盘的状态、存储峰值等

ModifyCloudDrivePermission.description_en: The default policy for the enterprise file storage is that all users can upload files from on-premises devices to the enterprise file storage, but cannot download files from the enterprise file storage to on-premises devices. You can invoke this API to add users with exception permissions
ModifyCloudDrivePermission.description_zh: 企业网盘的默认策略是所有用户均可从本地设备上传文件至企业网盘，但不可从企业网盘下载文件至本地设备。调用本接口可添加具备例外权限的用户

ModifyCloudDriveUsers.description_en: Modify basic properties of a user's personal disk, such as the status and storage capacity limit
ModifyCloudDriveUsers.description_zh: 修改用户个人盘的基本属性，例如个人盘的状态、存储峰值等

ModifyConfigGroup.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a configuration group, including the name and description
ModifyConfigGroup.description_zh: 修改配置组的基本信息，包括名称和描述

ModifyCustomizedListHeaders.description_en: Modifies the layouts of cloud computer list headers, such as the required fields and the display and hide settings
ModifyCustomizedListHeaders.description_zh: 修改云电脑列表页表头的显示类型（包括必选、显示和隐藏）

ModifyDesktopChargeType.description_en: Converts the billing method of cloud desktops to subscription or pay-as-you-go
ModifyDesktopChargeType.description_zh: 将云电脑的付费类型转为包年包月或按量付费

ModifyDesktopHostName.description_en: Modifies the hostname of a Windows cloud desktop in an AD office network
ModifyDesktopHostName.description_zh: 修改AD办公网络下的Windows云电脑的主机名称

ModifyDesktopName.description_en: Renames a specified cloud computer to a new name
ModifyDesktopName.description_zh: 将指定云电脑的名称修改为新名称

ModifyDesktopSpec.description_en: Changes the instance type of a cloud computer and expands the system cloud disk and data cloud disk of the cloud computer
ModifyDesktopSpec.description_zh: 变更云电脑的实例规格，并扩容云电脑的系统盘和数据盘

ModifyDesktopTimer.description_en: Creates or modifies scheduled tasks on cloud computers, such as starting, stopping, restarting, and resetting cloud computers on schedule
ModifyDesktopTimer.description_zh: 创建或修改云电脑定时任务，例如定时开机、关机、重启、重置等

ModifyDesktopsPolicyGroup.description_en: Changes an existing cloud computer policy for cloud computers
ModifyDesktopsPolicyGroup.description_zh: 为云电脑更换绑定的云电脑策略

ModifyDiskSpec.description_en: Modifies the performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk or data cloud disk of a cloud computer
ModifyDiskSpec.description_zh: 修改云电脑系统盘或数据盘的磁盘性能等级

ModifyEntitlement.description_en: Assigns a cloud computer to end users and removes all original end users of the cloud computer
ModifyEntitlement.description_zh: 将云电脑分配给指定用户，同时移除该云电脑此前已有的所有授权用户

ModifyImageAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an image, including the name and description of the image
ModifyImageAttribute.description_zh: 修改镜像的属性，包括镜像的名称和描述

ModifyImagePermission.description_en: Shares an image with other Alibaba Cloud accounts, or unshares an image from the recipient Alibaba Cloud accounts
ModifyImagePermission.description_zh: 将镜像共享给无影的其他用户或者取消已经共享的镜像

ModifyNASDefaultMountTarget.description_en: Modifies the mount target of a NAS file system
ModifyNASDefaultMountTarget.description_zh: 修改NAS文件系统的挂载点

ModifyNetworkPackageBandwidth.description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of a premium Internet bandwidth plan
ModifyNetworkPackageBandwidth.description_zh: 修改公网精品带宽的带宽大小

ModifyNetworkPackageEnabled.description_en: Restores or disables a premium bandwidth plan
ModifyNetworkPackageEnabled.description_zh: 恢复或停用公网精品带宽

ModifyOfficeSiteAttribute.description_en: Modifies the basic attributes of an office network (formerly workspace), such as the office network name and whether to grant local administrator permissions to cloud computer users
ModifyOfficeSiteAttribute.description_zh: 修改办公网络（原工作区）的基本属性，例如办公网络名称、是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限等

ModifyOfficeSiteBridgeInfo.description_en: Modifies the bridge information for behavior management
ModifyOfficeSiteBridgeInfo.description_zh: 修改行为管理网桥信息

ModifyOfficeSiteCrossDesktopAccess.description_en: Enables or disables the communication between cloud computers in an office network (formerly workspace). If you enable the communication between cloud computers in an office network, the cloud computers can access each other
ModifyOfficeSiteCrossDesktopAccess.description_zh: 开启或关闭办公网络（原工作区）内云电脑互通。开启后，同一个办公网络内的云电脑之间可以实现相互访问彼此的网络

ModifyOfficeSiteDnsInfo.description_en: Modifies the DNS information of an office network

ModifyOfficeSiteMfaEnabled.description_en: Enables or disables multi-factor authentication (MFA) for an enterprise Active Directory (AD) office network (formerly workspace)
ModifyOfficeSiteMfaEnabled.description_zh: 为AD办公网络（原工作区）开启或者关闭多因素认证MFA

ModifyQosEntries.description_en: Modifies the resource binding relationship of a rate limiting rule
ModifyQosEntries.description_zh: 修改限速规则资源绑定关系

ModifyQosRule.description_en: You can modify a rate limiting rule

ModifyResourceCenterPolicy.description_en: Modifies a global policy that is associated with a cloud resource
ModifyResourceCenterPolicy.description_zh: 修改与云资源绑定的无地域策略

ModifyTemplate.description_en: Modifies all parameters of a custom cloud computer template
ModifyTemplate.description_zh: 修改自定义云电脑模板的全部参数

ModifyTemplateBaseInfo.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a custom cloud computer template, including the template name and description
ModifyTemplateBaseInfo.description_zh: 修改自定义云电脑模板的基本信息，包括模板名称和模板描述

ModifyTimerGroup.description_en: Modifies the settings of a configuration group, such as scheduled task configurations
ModifyTimerGroup.description_zh: 修改配置组的具体设置，例如定时任务的配置

ModifyUserEntitlement.description_en: Adds or removes the authorization of one or more cloud computers for one or more users
ModifyUserEntitlement.description_zh: 为一个或多个用户新增或删除指定的一台或多台云电脑的授权

ModifyUserToDesktopGroup.description_en: Replaces the existing authorized users of a cloud computer share with different users
ModifyUserToDesktopGroup.description_zh: 将共享型云电脑的指定授权用户替换为其他指定授权用户

ModifyVirtualBridgeLevel.description_en: Changes the specifications of a virtual bridge

ModifyVirtualBridgeStatus.description_en: Modifies the status of a virtual bridge

MoveCdsFile.description_en: Moves a file or folder in a cloud disk to a new location
MoveCdsFile.description_zh: 将网盘中的文件或文件夹移动至新的位置

QueryHistoryActiveUserCount.description_en: Queries the historical daily active user count and monthly active user count for a specified date
QueryHistoryActiveUserCount.description_zh: 用于查询指定日期的历史日活跃用户数和月活跃用户数

QueryHistoryAvgMetricList.description_en: Queries the historical average monitoring metrics of desktop resources within a specified date range
QueryHistoryAvgMetricList.description_zh: 查询指定日期范围内桌面资源的历史平均监控指标

QueryHistoryMetricDistribution.description_en: Queries the historical distribution of a specific metric within a specified time range
QueryHistoryMetricDistribution.description_zh: 查询指定时间段内特定指标的历史分布情况

QueryHistoryUsageDurationRank.description_en: Queries and sorts historical usage duration by user or desktop dimension
QueryHistoryUsageDurationRank.description_zh: 按用户或桌面维度查询并排序历史使用时长

RebootDesktops.description_en: Restarts one or more cloud computers
RebootDesktops.description_zh: 重启一台或者多台云电脑

RebuildDesktops.description_en: Changes the image for one or more cloud computers
RebuildDesktops.description_zh: 为一台或多台云电脑变更镜像

RemoveFilePermission.description_en: Unshares a folder in a cloud disk
RemoveFilePermission.description_zh: 将网盘内的文件夹取消共享

RemoveUserFromDesktopGroup.description_en: Removes specified authorized users from a shared cloud computer. Removed users can no longer connect to cloud computers within the shared cloud computer
RemoveUserFromDesktopGroup.description_zh: 将共享型云电脑的指定授权用户移除出去。被移除的用户将无法再连接共享型云电脑内的云电脑

RenewDesktopGroup.description_en: Renews a subscription shared cloud computer
RenewDesktopGroup.description_zh: 为包年包月共享型云电脑续费

RenewDesktops.description_en: Renews one or more monthly subscription cloud computers
RenewDesktops.description_zh: 续费一台或者多台按月购买云电脑

RenewNetworkPackages.description_zh: 为包年包月公网精品带宽续费

ResetDesktops.description_en: Resets cloud computers within a shared cloud computer
ResetDesktops.description_zh: 重置共享型云电脑内的云电脑

ResetNASDefaultMountTarget.description_en: Resets the mount point of a NAS file system
ResetNASDefaultMountTarget.description_zh: 重置NAS文件系统的挂载点

ResetSnapshot.description_en: Recovers disk data from a snapshot
ResetSnapshot.description_zh: 恢复快照对应的磁盘数据

RevokeCoordinatePrivilege.description_en: Cancels the permissions for stream coordination operations

RunCommand.description_en: Executes a PowerShell or Bat script on one or more cloud computers that run Windows
RunCommand.description_zh: 在一台或多台Windows操作系统的云电脑中执行一段PowerShell或者Bat类型的脚本

SendVerifyCode.description_en: Retrieves a verification code required when adding a premium office network to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance that belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account
SendVerifyCode.description_zh: 将高级办公网络加入其他阿里云账号下的云企业网实例时，需要调用此接口获取验证码

SetDesktopGroupScaleTimer.description_en: Sets an automatic scaling policy for multi-session cloud computers. Multi-session cloud computers allow multiple users to connect to the same cloud computer simultaneously, which reduces costs
SetDesktopGroupScaleTimer.description_zh: 为多会话云电脑设置自动扩缩策略。多会话云电脑允许多个用户同时连接同一台云电脑，可节省成本

SetDesktopGroupTimer.description_en: Configures a scheduled start, stop, restart, or reset task for a cloud computer share
SetDesktopGroupTimer.description_zh: 设置共享型云电脑定时任务，执行定时开机、关机、重启或重置任务

SetDesktopGroupTimerStatus.description_en: Sets the status of a scheduled task for a shared cloud computer, such as enabling or disabling the scheduled task
SetDesktopGroupTimerStatus.description_zh: 设置共享型云电脑定时任务的状态，例如将定时任务设为启用或禁用

SetDesktopMaintenance.description_en: Sets the maintenance mode for cloud computers

SetDirectorySsoStatus.description_en: Enables or shuts down the single sign-on (SSO) feature for an AD-based office network
SetDirectorySsoStatus.description_zh: 为基于AD账号的办公网络开启或关闭单点登录SSO功能

SetIdpMetadata.description_en: Uploads metadata for a SAML 2.0-based identity provider (IdP)
SetIdpMetadata.description_zh: 上传基于SAML 2.0的身份提供商IdP（Identity Provider）的元数据

SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus.description_en: Enables or disables single sign-on (SSO) for an office network
SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus.description_zh: 为办公网络开启或关闭单点登录SSO功能

StartDesktops.description_en: Starts one or more stopped cloud computers. After the operation is called successfully, the cloud computers enter the Running state
StartDesktops.description_zh: 启动一台或者多台已停止的云电脑。接口调用成功后，云电脑进入运行中状态

StopDesktops.description_en: Stops one or more running cloud computers. After the operation is called, the cloud computers enter the Stopped state
StopDesktops.description_zh: 停止一台或者多台运行中的云电脑。接口调用成功后，云电脑进入已停止状态

StopInvocation.description_en: Stop a process that executes the Cloud Assistant script in one or more cloud computers
StopInvocation.description_zh: 停止一台或多台云电脑中的一条执行中云助手脚本的进程

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to specified cloud desktops. This makes it easier to filter and manage cloud desktops by tag
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的云电脑添加标签，方便通过标签统一筛选和管理云电脑

TransferTaskApprovalCallback.description_en: Submits the approval result for a file transfer task
TransferTaskApprovalCallback.description_zh: 提交文件传输审批结果

UnbindConfigGroup.description_zh: 将绑定在资源上的配置组解绑

UnlockVirtualMFADevice.description_en: Unlocks a virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device that is in the LOCKED state
UnlockVirtualMFADevice.description_zh: 解锁处于锁定（LOCKED）状态的虚拟MFA设备

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from cloud desktops. After a tag is removed, if the tag is not added to any cloud desktop, the tag is automatically deleted
UntagResources.description_zh: 为云电脑移除标签。移除标签后，如果该标签没有被添加到任何云电脑上，则标签会被自动删除

UpdateFotaTask.description_en: Enables or disables the auto-push feature for an image update task
UpdateFotaTask.description_zh: 为镜像升级任务打开或关闭自动推送

UploadImage.description_zh: 上传用户的自定义Windows镜像

VerifyCen.description_en: Verifies whether the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID and the associated Alibaba Cloud account ID are correct, and whether CIDR block conflicts exist between the instance routes and the office network IPv4 CIDR block
VerifyCen.description_zh: 校验云企业网实例ID与所属阿里云账号ID是否正确，以及实例路由与办公网络IPv4网段是否存在网段冲突

WakeupDesktops.description_en: Wakes up cloud computers from hibernation
WakeupDesktops.description_zh: 对云电脑执行唤醒操作
